CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Frontend-Killer** is a web-based game list manager for emulator frontends.
This repository ships the Community Applications template for Frontend-Killer: a self-hosted tool to import, manage, export and scrape game metadata and media across Pegasus, ES-DE, RetroBat, EmuELEC, Lakka and more, with full ScreenScraper integration (auto metadata/media download, CRC32 matching, quota monitoring). Runs on an embedded H2 database; all state is kept under `/data`.
- **Image:** `fansmall/frontendkiller:latest` (Docker Hub) - **Source:** https://github.com/fansmall2008/Frontend-Killer - **Support / issues:** https://github.com/fansmall2008/Frontend-Killer/issues
